name: Deep Mud
description: The mud greedily latches onto anything that lands in it, hampering movement.
disable: DC 15 Survival to navigate a safe path along the remaining bits of stone

generalAbilities.name: Squelch
generalAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature steps in the mud

Effect Deep mud sucks at the creature's feet. The triggering creature must attempt a Basic DC 16 Reflex Saving Throw save as they pull against the mud and struggle to stay upright. On a failure, the mud deals [[/r 2d4[bludgeoning] #Squelch]]{2d4 bludgeoning damage} and the creature falls Prone.
